## Complete Bundles (`complete-bundles`)

```html
<p>A wellness area works as one composition, not three separate purchases. Heat, cold water and fire, placed with the right distances between them.</p>
<p><strong>We build these as configured proposals rather than fixed listings.</strong> Every garden has different access, levels, power supply and sightlines, so a package that is right for one terrace is wrong for the next. Instead of publishing generic bundles, we specify yours.</p>
<h2>Compositions we plan most often</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Heat and fire</strong> — a barrel sauna such as the <a href="/products/auroom-halo-barrel-sauna">Halo</a> or <a href="/products/auroom-luma-barrel-sauna">Luma</a> with a <a href="/products/ecosmart-fire-mix-850-large-circular-concrete-fire-bowl">Mix 850</a> fire bowl as the gathering point outside the door.</li>
<li><strong>Cooking and fire</strong> — a <a href="/collections/outdoor-kitchens">Röshults outdoor kitchen</a> with a <a href="/products/ecosmart-fire-nova-850-architectural-fire-pit-bowl">Nova 850</a> defining the lounge end of the terrace.</li>
<li><strong>Architectural terrace</strong> — a <a href="/products/roshults-kitchen-island-4m-wall-anthracite">Kitchen Island 4M</a> as the spine of the space, with <a href="/products/ecosmart-fire-stix-architectural-bioethanol-fire-pit">Stix</a> as a linear fire line.</li>
</ul>
<h2>How to get a proposal</h2>
<p>Send the dimensions of the area, a photo, how many people it should serve and your delivery address. You will get a specification, a layout recommendation and a delivered price. <a href="/pages/consultation">Speak with a specialist</a>.</p>
```

## Barrel Saunas (`barrel-saunas`) — THE SCREENSHOT COLLECTION

```html
<p>Shop VeldoraHaven's range of <strong>premium outdoor barrel saunas</strong> — four Auroom models designed for year-round outdoor use in Northern European climates. <p>Choose from the compact <strong>Halo</strong> (available in 120cm, 150cm and 180cm diameter), the popular <strong>Luma</strong> with its signature outdoor porch (225cm, 260cm and 300cm lengths), the square-section <strong>Nora</strong> for a contemporary footprint, or the spacious <strong>Sola</strong> — our largest model for serious enthusiasts.</p>

<p>Not sure which model is right for your garden? <a href="/pages/consultation">Speak with a specialist</a> or visit our <a href="/pages/faq">FAQ</a> for answers to the most common questions.</p><h2>Before you order</h2><p>Read the <a href="/blogs/outdoor-living/outdoor-sauna-buying-guide">outdoor sauna buying guide</a> for sizing, heater output and installation requirements.</p>
```

## Cabin Saunas (`cabin-saunas`)

```html
<p>Where a barrel is an object in the garden, a cabin is a building. Full-height glazing, a proper doorway, room for a changing area — these are structures designed to be looked at from the house as much as used. Most models arrive as pre-assembled sections that two adults can raise in a day, without requiring specialist contractors for the structure itself. A dedicated 230V circuit is required for the heater installation and must be completed by a qualified electrician before first use.</p><h2>Before you order</h2><p>Read the <a href="/blogs/outdoor-living/outdoor-sauna-buying-guide">outdoor sauna buying guide</a> for sizing, heater output and installation requirements.</p>
```

## Outdoor Kitchens (`outdoor-kitchens`)

```html
<p>Röshults outdoor kitchens are designed and made in Jönköping, Sweden. Each configuration is built from modular units — grill, sink, storage — that share a finish, a height, and a material language, so the assembled kitchen reads as a single piece of furniture rather than a collection of appliances.</p>

<p>The Essentials range offers a complete freestanding setup in three units. It installs without a fixed structure on any level surface, and can be repositioned as your space evolves. Available in Stainless Steel with a charcoal grill, or Beluga Black with a gas grill.</p>

<p>The Kitchen Island range is built to order. The 4M Wall and 5M Bar formats accommodate multiple cooking methods alongside a teak module and a large-format sink. The bar format is open on both sides. The wall format anchors one edge of the terrace. Both are available in Stainless Steel or Anthracite.</p>

<p>All products are manufactured in Sweden and delivered directly to your site. Freight is quoted per delivery address and confirmed before the order is placed.</p>

<p>If the configurations shown here don't fit your space, contact us. We work with the full Röshults catalogue and can put together a bespoke specification to order.</p><h2>Planning your kitchen</h2><p>Our <a href="/blogs/outdoor-living/outdoor-kitchen-planning-guide">outdoor kitchen planning guide</a> covers module combinations, layout depths and clearances, charcoal versus gas, and how stainless steel, anthracite and teak behave outdoors over time.</p>
```

## Outdoor Baths & Hot Tubs (`outdoor-baths-hot-tubs`)

```html
<h2>Outdoor Baths &amp; Hot Tubs — A Considered Guide</h2><p>There is a particular quality to bathing outdoors that no indoor room can replicate — the relationship between warm water and cold air, the shift in atmosphere from dusk to dark, the reduction of the world to the edge of a tub. Outdoor hot tubs and baths have been a fixture of Nordic and Japanese culture for generations, and the European residential market has developed products of equivalent craft and durability.</p><p>Our range is drawn from a small number of manufacturers, selected against the same criteria we apply across the store: construction quality, honesty of the materials specification, and documented performance in year-round outdoor use. We list wood-fired cedar hot tubs for those who want the ritual of the fire alongside the soak, and premium outdoor showers designed specifically for post-sauna and poolside use. We do not list inflatable products or unbranded imports.</p><h3>How to Choose Your Outdoor Hot Tub or Bath</h3><p><strong>Wood-fired vs electrically heated</strong> — Wood-fired systems require no mains connection and suit off-grid or rural installations. They take 2–3 hours to reach temperature and reward the preparation. Electrically heated systems maintain a constant set temperature and are ready on demand.</p><p><strong>Material</strong> — Western red cedar is the industry standard: naturally rot-resistant, aromatic, and dimensionally stable in outdoor conditions. Stainless steel tubs offer a more architectural appearance and are easier to clean. Both carry appropriate warranties for outdoor exposure.</p><p><strong>Capacity</strong> — Standard cedar hot tubs accommodate 4–6 adults. Consider the flow of access around the tub, not just the seating inside it.</p><h3>Delivery and Installation</h3><p>All outdoor hot tubs and bath products ship by pallet freight on a scheduled date confirmed with you in advance. Wood-fired cedar tubs require a level base, a cold-water supply, and a drainage solution — the full requirements are set out on each product page. We confirm access and placement by telephone before dispatch.</p><h3>Frequently Asked Questions</h3><p><strong>Does a wood-fired hot tub require planning permission?</strong> Regulations vary. In most cases a freestanding garden installation does not require a permit, but we recommend confirming with your local authority.</p><p><strong>How long does a cedar tub last?</strong> Western red cedar tubs from reputable manufacturers regularly last 20–30 years with appropriate care. The staves expand and seal naturally when filled with water.</p><p><strong>How often should the water be changed?</strong> Without chemical treatment, weekly changes are advisable. With appropriate sanitisation, water can be maintained for longer periods.</p><p><strong>Can the tub be left outside in winter?</strong> Yes, provided it is either kept filled (water weight stabilises the staves) or fully drained and dried. Winterisation guidance is included with delivery.</p><p><strong>Is white-glove placement available?</strong> Placement beyond the kerbside can be quoted at the time of order, subject to access and terrain. Tell us the site conditions when you order and we will confirm what is possible and what it costs.</p>
```

*(Note: this one is structurally very different from the rest — much longer, FAQ-style with bold micro-headers used as pseudo-labels ("Wood-fired vs electrically heated —", "Material —", "Capacity —"). Reads like a different content pass/voice from the shorter collections. Worth flagging to the user as its own case — may want a different treatment than a simple debold pass.)*

## Cold Plunge (`cold-plunge-ice-baths`)

```html
<p>Cold water is the other half of a Nordic wellness routine. A short immersion after heat is what turns a sauna from a warm room into a practice.</p>
<p><strong>Our cold-water assortment is being finalised for the European market.</strong> We only publish products once we have verified the specification that matters here — voltage and plug standard, chiller performance at Northern European ambient temperatures, filtration, insulation for winter use, and freight to your address. - **Clean/restrained** (little or no `<strong>`, reads as calm prose): Cabin Saunas, Outdoor Kitchens, Complete Bundles, Cold Plunge, Outdoor Furniture & Pergolas — these already match the brand voice well.
```
- **Heavy inline bold** (multiple `<strong>` per paragraph on product names/features, listy feel): Saunas, Barrel Saunas (the screenshot), Fire Features, Sauna Accessories — these are the ones that need the debold/rewrite pass.
- **Outdoor Baths & Hot Tubs** is its own case — much longer, FAQ-structured, different voice entirely.
